learning_outcomes.text: Understand technical texts specific to the specialization.
Analyze the characteristics of technical French.
Write texts related to the specialization.
Analyze the characteristics of various texts.
Elaborate small descriptions and specific procedures.

syllabus_topics: First contacts: Places, greeting and introduction rituals, origin and profession. Personalities.
Behavior in everyday situations. Buying and paying. Forms of payment.
Leisure and free time: activities and shows. Tastes and preferences.
The world of work. Situation of some time indicators.
Spatial orientation. Reading a plan, describing a spatial organization.
French phonetics: Rules of pronunciation and intonation.
Present tense of auxiliary verbs. Regular verbs in "er".
Present tense of main irregular verbs.
Le passé composé and the agreement of the past participle.
teaching_methods: Class activities focused on real communication situations
Self-learning activities focused on real communication situations
Listening comprehension (understanding short conversations about daily life)
Oral expression (usual courtesy formulas, asking and giving information, etc.)
assessment_rules: For students with regular attendance (80%), evaluation is continuous and consists of an 80% written final test (minimum 40% required) and 20% for individual and group assignments (timely submission required). For students without regular attendance, the final written exam accounts for 100% of the final grade. An oral test is required to be taken after passing the written final exam. Students who do not attend the exam are considered 'Not Presented'. Extraordinary call follows the same conditions as the ordinary call.
